definitions.success: correct logical target and full-cell-box IoU >= 0.5
definitions.wrong: another GT row/column has strictly higher IoU than intended target; denominator=offered cell locations
definitions.region_baseline: each supplied table crop has a region; no cell coordinates are fabricated
definitions.rapid: same production topology/text gate; SLANet+ structure prediction boxes, no detector-support requirement
definitions.borderless-visual-fintabnet: all 40 FinTabNet crops visually inspected after freezing; no full cell grid (horizontal rules and shaded rows allowed). Additional descriptive tags only, no reselection or model tuning.
definitions.timings: Paddle GPU and Rapid CPU are different execution backends; no direct hardware speed claim
